doc.title: Joanne Brackeen interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 10, 2001

title: Swimming and Marian McPartland
summary: Asked if she has more to add, she mentions swimming, then praises Marian McPartland and the Penthouse duets.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well is there anything I haven’t asked you that you’d like to talk about?
I just had a swimming class yesterday. That was fun. Kind of cold for a while, I kind of did it.
Well you said you like to be near the water, so it keeps you healthy. I know you’ve done Marian McPartland’s show.

A couple of times. She’s a good friend. She’s always calling. She’s an amazing person. Always sending me articles, she does this with people, sends them articles on themselves that they never would have seen. She’s unbelievable, as well as getting better at the piano. I think she’s playing this week at the, it’s part of Lincoln Center, where they have duets. The Penthouse.
They have a nice piano there as a matter of fact.
Oh. I tried to go when Joe Lovano and Gonzalo were there but it was totally sold out both nights so.
Wow. Well we can only hope that we’ll be that vital when we get that age I think. She was at Hamilton in September. She did a great show.
